scope: Additive Home Village TH18 reference delta for Inferno Dragon's independently documented three-stage beam; it preserves every preceding reference artifact.
game_version: The immutable level payload is source commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Official balance notes and the secondary current table do not identify the target client build, so it remains explicitly unknown.

sources.title: New Levels & Balance Changes!
sources.limitations: The official balance note states that the beam ramp-up was slowed by 0.2 seconds, but does not publish the resulting stage boundaries or the per-level damage table.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: The official note changes the beam cooldown from 0.5 to 0.6 seconds, but does not establish target-loss, range, collision, flight or effect interactions.

sources.title: Inferno Dragon | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The consulted table gives 1.7/3.2-second stage boundaries and per-level stage DPS including L12 90/182/1,820, but no version-pinned reset, timing-order, range or collision contract.

official_deltas.behavior: Beam cooldown is 0.6 seconds after the Town Hall 14 update.
Beam ramp-up was slowed by 0.2 seconds in the Autumn 2021 update.

inferno_ramp.note: Secondary current-table stage boundaries; Core quantizes both values to kTickMs and does not reuse Inferno Tower timings.

support.note: Core uses the independent stage contract with the source cooldown. Lock reset on target loss and direct beam impact are explicitly documented deterministic approximations pending a versioned public contract.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued Super Troop with an evidence audit that prohibited reusing Inferno Tower timings
changed_values.replacement: independent 1.7/3.2-second, three-stage beam contract using the already sourced 0.6-second cooldown and secondary stage DPS records
changed_values.justification: The lenient integration goal permits a documented deterministic implementation where the available primary and secondary evidence is sufficient for broad functional coverage but not full fidelity.

known_uncertainties: No located version-identified source defines target-loss/reset, Freeze/Rage, movement, range measurement, altitude, beam hit timing, splash behavior, collision geometry or visual fidelity for the frozen version.
The primary sources do not publish per-level stage DPS or exact post-change boundaries.

Core therefore treats the beam as a direct impact and resets its serialized lock when the current target changes, dies, or leaves range. These are deterministic approximations, not claimed game-exact rules.
conclusion: This additive versioned reference preserves the 2026-09-17 ledger and all preceding deltas while exposing Inferno Dragon through the common Core, GUI and RL path with explicit uncertainty.
